validation_notes: The chart shows a clear, persistent downtrend from ~7.2 to ~6.4 with lower highs and lower lows throughout, not a consolidating triangle. A descending triangle requires a flat horizontal support base with repeated bounces at the same level, which is absent here; the support is also sloping down, not flat. Near the right edge, price is still declining with no sign of compression or basing - it just made a new low around 6.35-6.4 and is drifting sideways-to-down. This looks like trend continuation, not an apex-forming triangle, so I disagree with the algorithm's descending triangle (LONG) call.
